/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:97:1. `--api-key` — must be an `sk_` key. A `mcpjam_…` legacy key is a usage error.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:109:Every command that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides it
s server when it starts, before it contacts anything. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not a
n `http(s)` URL, or that carries credentials, a query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables nam
ing different servers. The error masks credentials, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved
login is only sent to its own server: when it is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before
any request. `mcpjam cloud status` uses the same checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok:
false`, includes `credential.valid` / `deployment.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informati
onal (`credential.valid: null`) and successful.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:123:Empty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** select
a Cloud CLI project (it is SDK eval reporting only).

usage`. Capped at 4 concurrent turns per organization and \~90 s wall clock. **Not idempotent — never blind-retry**: dedupe on you
r own trigger identity, and on an error response check `details.createdResources` (and, after a lost response, list suites) before
retrying, or you'll create duplicates |

36:## Usage limits
38:The hosted app uses a daily credit system to power AI features like chat.
40:* **Guests** get a free daily usage allowance. Higher-priced models are greyed out in the model picker with a "Sign in to use t
his model" tooltip — sign in to unlock them. The sidebar shows a progress bar with how much of your daily limit you've used and wh
en it resets. When you reach the limit, you'll be prompted to sign in.
42:* **Signed-in users** get **10×** the daily usage of a guest. Your daily usage and any paid credit balance are visible in the a
ccount menu at the bottom of the sidebar.
43:* **Paid credits** can be topped up from the billing page and are shown alongside your daily limit in the account menu.
44:* **Low credits warning** — when your credit balance drops to 10% or below, the sidebar credit meter turns red and shows a **Lo
w credits** label.
45:* **When credits run out**, only the free hosted models are locked. Models you access with your own API key (BYOK) remain avail
